aka.zh: 佳鹅公路（鹅銮鼻—佳乐水段）

tagline.en: Round the Hengchun peninsula from Fenggang through Kenting to the Pacific shore, in three pieces, its last gap left as a nature reserve over the Alangyi trail
tagline.zh: 自枫港经垦丁绕行恒春半岛至太平洋岸，全线分为三段，最后一处缺口因阿塱壹古道划为自然保留区而不再修建

start.en: Fenggang, Fangshan, Pingtung, at Provincial Highway 9, a little south of where Highway 1 ends
start.zh: 屏东县枋山乡枫港，衔接台 9 线，台 1 线终点在其南侧不远

end.en: Anshuo, Daren, Taitung, where it meets Provincial Highway 9 on the South Link coast
end.zh: 台东县达仁乡安朔，于南回公路海岸段衔接台 9 线

en: Provincial Highway 26 is the road round the Hengchun peninsula, the southern tip of Taiwan. From Fenggang it runs south down the west coast through Checheng and Hengchun, then through the length of Kenting National Park — South Bay, Kenting town and beach, Chuanfanshi, Eluanbi — before turning north up the east coast to Gangkou by Jialeshui. It passes Hengchun airport, Longluan Lake and the Third Nuclear Power Plant. It is the main road to Kenting.

The directorate plans it at 93.5 km to Anshuo in Taitung, but only about 67.5 km is open, in three pieces that do not meet: Fenggang to Gangkou, Gangzai to Xuhai, and Xianantian to Anshuo. About 16.5 km between Gangkou and Gangzai, along the Jialeshui and Nanrenshan coast of the national park, was struck off the route in 2005. The second gap, from Xuhai to Nantian, is the Alangyi trail, a coast that Pingtung County and conservation groups call Taiwan's last natural shoreline, and was never built. The atlas draws the route as those three pieces.
zh: 台 26 线是环绕台湾最南端恒春半岛的公路。它自枫港沿西海岸南下，经车城、恒春，再纵贯垦丁国家公园——南湾、垦丁街区与海滩、船帆石、鹅銮鼻——之后折向北，沿东海岸至佳乐水附近的港口。沿途经过恒春机场、龙銮潭与第三核能发电厂，是前往垦丁的主要道路。
公路局规划全长 93.5 公里，终于台东安朔，但通车的只有约 67.5 公里，分为互不相连的三段：枫港至港口、港仔至旭海、下南田至安朔。港口至港仔约 16.5 公里位于国家公园佳乐水、南仁山海岸，已于 2005 年解编。另一处缺口旭海至南田，就是阿塱壹古道——屏东县政府与环保团体称之为台湾最后的自然海岸线——始终没有修建。地图因此把这条路画成三段。

en: The western half was the end of Highway 1, the Ping-E section from Fenggang to Eluanbi. It was given its own number, Highway 24, in 1977, and renumbered 26 in 1994. In August 2009, when the Fenggang bypass was taken into Highway 9, the start moved to the Maliba bridge.

The Alangyi coast was a road before it was a gap. After the Mudan incident the Qing opened a route from Hengchun to Beinan, and by 1877 the coastal stretch north from Bayao Bay to the Anshuo River was open. Late in the Second World War the Japanese army blew up parts of the roadbed for fear of an American landing at Mudan Bay. About 4 km of shore from Xuhai over the Mudan and Guanyin headlands to the Tawa River survives, long kept quiet by military controls.

The highways directorate set out to close the gap in the 2000s. An environmental impact assessment for an Anshuo–Gangkou improvement plan passed in 2002; in 2003 the Executive Yuan approved an 11.9 km Xuhai–Anshuo road in six contracts; land was expropriated in 2005 and work began in Taitung in 2006. On the Pingtung side the coastal road was redesigned in 2006 with two tunnels through the headlands. The changed plan passed a further environmental review on 1 December 2010 (Chinese Wikipedia gives 1 October), after which conservation groups campaigned against its budget.

Pingtung County then moved first. It declared a provisional reserve on 1 February 2011, and on 20 January 2012 the Xuhai–Guanyinbi Nature Reserve, 841.3 hectares, in which development is barred. The Taitung end, from the Tawa River to Anshuo, opened on 13 May 2011. Taitung County protested that the reserve had been drawn to stop the road and asked the Council of Agriculture to revoke it, without success. In 2015 the directorate began returning the expropriated land, and in April 2018 its Fenggang office said there was no longer a plan to build the last 7 km.
zh: 西半段原是台 1 线的末段，即枫港至鹅銮鼻的屏鹅公路。1977 年独立编号为台 24 线，1994 年改编为台 26 线。2009 年 8 月，枫港外环道纳编为台 9 线，台 26 线起点随之移至麻里巴大桥。
阿塱壹海岸先有路，后成缺口。牡丹社事件后，清廷开辟自恒春通往卑南的琅峤—卑南道，1877 年自八瑶湾沿海岸北至安朔溪的路段开通。二战末期，日军为防美军自牡丹湾登陆，自行炸毁附近部分古道路基。如今仅存旭海经牡丹鼻、观音鼻至塔瓦溪约四公里海岸，因长期军事管制而保持原貌。

2000 年代，公路总局着手打通这一缺口。2002 年，台 26 线安朔至港口段公路整体改善计划通过环评；2003 年，行政院同意办理旭海至安朔段拓建计划，长约 11.9 公里，分六标；2005 年完成土地征收，2006 年台东段开工。屏东段于 2006 年变更设计，以两座隧道穿过岬角取代滨海平面道路。变更案于 2010 年 12 月 1 日通过环境影响差异分析（中文维基百科记为 10 月 1 日），其后环保团体串联阻挡预算。

屏东县政府随即抢先一步。2011 年 2 月 1 日公告暂定自然保留区，2012 年 1 月 20 日正式公告“旭海观音鼻自然保留区”，面积 841.3 公顷，禁止开发。台东端塔瓦溪至安朔段于 2011 年 5 月 13 日通车。台东县政府抗议保留区是为阻断台 26 线而划，并行文农委会要求撤销，未获结果。2015 年，公路总局启动废止征收、归还土地；2018 年 4 月，公路总局枫港工务段表示最后 7 公里已无兴建计划。

en: No cost has been published for the road as a whole, most of which is an old provincial road. The one priced project is the gap. In 2003 the Xuhai–Anshuo plan was approved at about NT$1.858 billion. With the tunnels added, the figure reported in December 2010 was NT$3.8 billion. In May 2018 the directorate's Third District office put the Pingtung tunnels, about 3 km through the Guanyin and Mudan headlands, at a first estimate of NT$3 billion, NT$2.7 billion of it for the tunnels, and said the work could go ahead only if Pingtung lifted or redrew the reserve.
zh: 全线没有公布过总造价，其中大部分是旧有省道。唯一有价格的项目是那处缺口。2003 年核定的旭海至安朔段计划总经费约 18.58 亿元；改走隧道后，2010 年 12 月报道的经费增至 38 亿元。2018 年 5 月，公路总局第三区养护工程处称，屏东段穿越观音鼻与牡丹鼻山的隧道总长约 3 公里，初估工程费 30 亿元，其中隧道约 27 亿元，且须屏东县政府解除或修正保留区范围才能推动。

en: Speed limits are 40 to 70 km/h. Gangzai to Xuhai is a single-lane road past the Jiupeng base of the Chungshan Institute of Science and Technology, and was long under military checks. To get round the gaps, from Gangkou take County Road 200A to Xinzhuang and County Road 200 through Manzhou to Gangzai; from Xuhai take County Road 199A to Shangmudan, County Road 199 to Shouka and Highway 9E to Anshuo.

The Alangyi trail itself can be walked, by permit. Under its 2012 rules Pingtung admits 300 people a day to the reserve, and walkers must hire a local guide, one for every group of up to twenty. The road that was to replace the detour was designed for about 14 minutes over 11.8 km; the way round is about 32 km and takes about an hour.
zh: 全线限速每小时 40 至 70 公里。港仔至旭海为单线道，邻近中科院九鹏基地，过去长期实施军事管制、人车须受检查。绕过缺口：自港口经县道 200 甲线至新庄，再经县道 200 号过满州至港仔；自旭海经县道 199 甲线至上牡丹，再经县道 199 号至寿峠，接台 9 戊线至安朔。
阿塱壹古道本身可申请步行进入。按 2012 年的规定，屏东县每日限 300 人进入保留区，且须聘请解说员，每二十人以下的团体一位。原计划的新路长约 11.8 公里，车程约 14 分钟；现行绕道约 32 公里，车程约一小时。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. Most of the road is the old Highway 1 and Highway 24 alignment, upgraded over decades in the ordinary provincial budget; only the unbuilt Xuhai–Anshuo gap has been priced, listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线造价。大部分路段是旧台 1 线、台 24 线路线，数十年间在一般省道预算中逐步改善；只有尚未修通的旭海至安朔段有过估价，另列如下。

why.en: No breakdown has been published. The Xuhai–Anshuo project was approved by the Executive Yuan in 2003 and run by the Directorate General of Highways; who contributed what to it, or to the older sections, was not found.
why.zh: 未见出资构成公布。旭海至安朔段计划于 2003 年经行政院同意，由交通部公路总局办理；该段及其余旧路段由何方出资多少，未查到。

label.zh: 旭海至安朔段计划（11.9 公里，核定时）

value.en: About NT$1.858 billion, approved in 2003, in six contracts
value.zh: 总经费约新台币 18.58 亿元，2003 年核定，分六标

figures.source: Directorate General of Highways, Third District Maintenance Office, reported by Merit Times news agency (人間通訊社), 13 May 2011

label.zh: 旭海至安朔段（改隧道后）

value.en: Reported at NT$3.8 billion in December 2010 (up from NT$1.8 billion); in May 2018 the Pingtung tunnels alone were put at a first estimate of NT$3 billion, NT$2.7 billion of it for about 3 km of tunnel
value.zh: 2010 年 12 月报道为 38 亿元（原为 18 亿元）；2018 年 5 月，屏东段隧道方案初估 30 亿元，其中约 3 公里隧道占 27 亿元

figures.source: Environmental Information Center (環境資訊中心), 5 December 2010; Liberty Times, 8 May 2018, quoting the DGH Third District Maintenance Office

value.en: 93.5 km planned, about 67.49 km open. The 2009 adjustment gave 93.823 km. The Alangyi gap is given as about 8.5 km by Chinese Wikipedia and 7 km by the directorate's Fenggang office.
value.zh: 规划 93.5 公里，通车约 67.49 公里；2009 年调整时为 93.823 公里。阿塱壹缺口长度，中文维基百科作约 8.5 公里，公路总局枫港工务段作 7 公里。

figures.source: Directorate General of Highways route list, as cited in Chinese and English Wikipedia, 台26線 / Provincial Highway 26; Executive Yuan Gazette 15(159), 20 August 2009, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia; United Daily News, 18 April 2018

label.zh: 旭海观音鼻自然保留区

value.en: 841.3 hectares, declared by Pingtung County on 20 January 2012; 300 visitors a day
value.zh: 841.3 公顷，屏东县政府 2012 年 1 月 20 日公告；每日限 300 人

figures.source: Pingtung County Government announcement, 20 January 2012, and 屏東縣旭海觀音鼻自然保留區管理辦法, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 阿朗壹古道

timeline.en: The Qing coastal road north from Bayao Bay to the Anshuo River, the later Alangyi trail, is opened.
timeline.zh: 清廷开通自八瑶湾沿海岸北至安朔溪的道路，即日后的阿塱壹古道。

timeline.en: The Fenggang–Eluanbi end of Highway 1 is numbered Highway 24.
timeline.zh: 台 1 线枫港至鹅銮鼻段独立编为台 24 线。
台 24 线改编为台 26 线。

timeline.en: The Executive Yuan approves an 11.9 km Xuhai–Anshuo road at about NT$1.858 billion.
timeline.zh: 行政院同意办理旭海至安朔段拓建计划，长约 11.9 公里，总经费约 18.58 亿元。

timeline.en: Gangkou–Gangzai is struck off the route on 21 January; land for Xuhai–Anshuo is expropriated.
timeline.zh: 1 月 21 日，港口至港仔段公告解编；旭海至安朔段完成土地征收。

timeline.en: Work starts at the Taitung end; the Pingtung section is redesigned with two tunnels.
timeline.zh: 台东端开工；屏东段变更设计，改以两座隧道通过。

timeline.en: The start moves to the Maliba bridge on 17 August, when the Fenggang bypass joins Highway 9.
timeline.zh: 8 月 17 日，枫港外环道纳编台 9 线，起点移至麻里巴大桥。

timeline.en: The tunnel design passes its environmental review in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，隧道方案通过环境影响差异分析。

timeline.en: Pingtung declares a provisional reserve on 1 February; Tawa River–Anshuo opens on 13 May.
timeline.zh: 2 月 1 日，屏东县公告暂定自然保留区；5 月 13 日，塔瓦溪至安朔段通车。

timeline.en: The Xuhai–Guanyinbi Nature Reserve is declared on 20 January, halting the last section.
timeline.zh: 1 月 20 日，旭海观音鼻自然保留区正式公告，最后路段停工。

timeline.en: The directorate begins returning the expropriated land.
timeline.zh: 公路总局启动废止征收，归还土地。

timeline.en: In April the directorate's Fenggang office says there is no longer a plan to build the last 7 km.
timeline.zh: 4 月，公路总局枫港工务段表示最后 7 公里已无兴建计划。
